verdict.rationale: A scraping API platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. AI-based extraction (`ai_query`), the ChatGPT/Gemini proxy APIs, and the MCP server for external agents are adjacent features, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
